patterns: Bhopal gas tragedy dominates: gas = methyl isocyanate (MIC), date 2-3 Dec 1984, Union Carbide - asked as plain one-liners in APPSC and other PSCs.
Disaster -> pollutant pairs recur (Minamata = mercury); APPSC-relevant LG Polymers (styrene, Vizag) is a likely AP tilt.
Institution -> headquarters questions (FRI Dehradun, est. 1906; ICFRE Dehradun; NBA/CBPL Chennai) are frequent direct recall items.
PYQs are single-fact recall; the app adds many statement/match items on CEPI, classification and current rules that go deeper than the exam shows.
Odd-one-out on 'not environment-related institution' (Survey of India) is a common trap shape.
